resources.string: Everything plays from your phone. No internet needed.
MP3, M4A, OGG, FLAC or WAV. The file is copied into the app, so it keeps working offline. Long files use the first 3 minutes as a seamless loop.

Use your own shower recording instead of the built-in one. It is copied into the app and works offline.

Keep the volume low, at or below the level of your tinnitus and never louder than normal conversation. Loud sound can make tinnitus worse. Stop if you feel discomfort, pressure or pain. The app limits digital peaks, but it cannot know how loud your headphones are, so the safe level is the one that feels comfortable to you.

Tinnitus Relief plays calming sound to make tinnitus less noticeable. It does not diagnose, treat or cure tinnitus. If your tinnitus is new, one-sided, pulsing, or comes with hearing loss or dizziness, see a doctor. No accounts, no ads, no data leaves your phone.
A separate space for exploring personalised sound and recording how your tinnitus responds. It never changes the Relief player.
Pitch matching with a logarithmic tuner, a signal generator, and a simple before/after relief test stored only on your phone.
Lab features are experimental. They are not a clinical measurement or treatment.
